name: CT/PET Modality Fusion via Pseudo-HU Mapping
aliases: CT/PET modality fusion via pseudo-HU mapping
definition: Aligns independently acquired CT and PET image stacks and fuses them into a single dataset using a continuous pseudo-Hounsfield Unit (pseudo-HU) scale to enable joint structural and functional visualization.
summary: CT/PET Modality Fusion via Pseudo-HU Mapping aligns CT and PET stacks into a single scalar field where PET signals override CT values above a threshold, creating a unified 0–999 integer range for volume rendering.
